property_summary: After deployment by owner (address(this)), calling XBornID() from a non-owner, non-zero address (here address(0x101)) causes the reference to revert due to msg.sender != owner, leaving balances[owner] unchanged at 0; the buggy version succeeds because msg.sender == address(0x1) is false but the require condition is address(0x1) which is not the caller, so it reverts as well — wait, need correct scenario: actually the bug requires msg.sender == address(0x1), so calling from address(0x1) succeeds in bug and reverts in reference, making balances[owner] differ: bug sets it to totalDistributed, reference leaves it at 0.
change_summary: Replace the owner address check with an arbitrary different address to only allow a different owner to initialize.
